task: Audit and remediate Archive Module manuscript viewing and downloading failures
role: Principal Systems Architect & Full-Stack Specialist (BukSU CMS-V2)
root_causes_identified: Phantom Endpoint Bug: GET /api/projects/:id/manuscript did not exist in server/modules/projects/project.routes.js, returning 404 for viewing and downloads.
Storage Disconnect: Projects store metadata while manuscripts reside as Submission documents ('final_academic', 'final_journal') in S3/filesystem storage without direct links.

RBAC 403 Barrier: submission.service.js:_assertCanViewSubmission hardcoded allowArchivedFinalJournalPublicView strictly to 'final_journal', rejecting public access to 'final_academic' manuscripts and rejecting submission listing for non-team members on archived projects.
Direct download handler in CanonicalDocumentViewer fallback opened manuscriptUrl without appending download=true query parameter.

modifications_applied.action: Registered GET /:projectId/manuscript accessible to authenticated students, instructors, and faculty.
Added getProjectManuscript controller supporting HTTP 206 range streaming, Accept-Ranges, and Content-Disposition download/inline toggles.
Added getProjectManuscript service checking archived public exemption vs in-progress committee authorization, resolving target submission, and streaming through storage pipeline.
Expanded _assertCanViewSubmission to grant institutional access to approved submissions ('final_academic', 'final_journal', 'final_paper') for archived projects and allow listing submissions.
Exposed projectService.getProjectManuscript(id, params) preserving API route parity.
Enhanced handleDownloadPdf to append download=true query parameter and trigger direct authenticated streaming.
Added targeted test suite covering archived access, in-progress access control, type filtering, and 404 handling.

learned_lessons: Lesson: Institutional archive reading requires public-within-university visibility across all final submission types (both 'final_academic' and 'final_journal'), not just journal submissions.
Prevention: When exposing downloadable document endpoints in Express, always pair with HTTP 206 partial content range support and Content-Disposition filename headers for cross-browser stability.

Runbook: To verify archive document viewing and downloading, check GET /api/projects/:projectId/manuscript and verify submission.service.js:_assertCanViewSubmission allows archived project submissions.
